roles.name: Technical Administrator
roles.description: Administers the technical platform (settings, backups, organisation structure, role catalogue). Holds no police operational authority and reads no police data.

roles.name: Security Administrator
roles.description: Manages accounts, sessions and security settings and reads the audit log. Holds no police operational authority and reads no police data.

roles.name: National Commander
roles.description: National oversight: reads everything, approves warrants, wanted notices, operations and reports.

roles.name: Regional Commander
roles.description: Commands all stations of a region.

roles.name: Departmental Commander
roles.description: Commands the police structures of one administrative department.

roles.name: Station Commander
roles.description: Commands a police station: reviews complaints, assigns cases, supervises investigations.

roles.name: Investigator
roles.description: Leads investigations on assigned cases: persons, statements, interviews, evidence, warrants requests, arrests.

roles.name: Desk / Duty Officer
roles.description: Front desk: registers complaints, persons and incidents.

roles.name: Patrol Officer
roles.description: Field officer: patrols and incident reporting.

roles.name: Evidence Custodian
roles.description: Manages the evidence room and chain of custody.

roles.name: Custody Officer
roles.description: Manages detention cells and detainee welfare logs.

roles.name: Fleet Manager
roles.description: Manages vehicles, maintenance and fuel for a region.

roles.name: Crime Analyst
roles.description: Read-only national analytics and reporting.

roles.name: Auditor
roles.description: Read-only access to all records and the audit log.

roles.name: Biometric Officer
roles.description: Runs fingerprint, face, voice and ANPR searches and records investigator verification of matches.

roles.name: Forensic Officer
roles.description: Manages forensic evidence and chain of custody; enrolls biometric templates and runs fingerprint searches.

roles.name: Prosecutor
roles.description: Legal oversight: read-only access to cases, evidence and biometric activity, including sensitive and confidential records.

roles.name: Police Administrator
roles.description: National administration of the police information system: users, organization and every traffic function, without system security or backup settings.

roles.name: HR Director
roles.description: Direction des ressources humaines: HR dossiers and career decisions (promotion, appointment, status, retirement) for the whole police.

roles.name: Payroll Officer
roles.description: Pay and benefits: requests pay scale changes and pay elements and generates the monthly statements. Cannot validate or export (separation of duties).

roles.name: Payroll Controller
roles.description: Pay control: validates pay scale changes, pay elements and monthly statements, and exports them to the financial services. Cannot create the data it validates.

roles.name: HR Service Officer
roles.description: Human resources service: maintains HR dossiers; cannot record career decisions.

roles.name: Police Officer
roles.description: Police officer (OPJ): records traffic controls and PV, maintains driver and vehicle records, registers persons.

roles.name: Traffic Officer
roles.description: Traffic police officer: roadside controls, electronic PV, evidence photos, driver and vehicle records.

roles.name: Traffic Control Agent
roles.description: Roadside control agent: records controls and issues PV; reads driver and vehicle records but cannot edit them.

roles.name: Traffic Supervisor
roles.description: Supervises traffic enforcement for a unit: reviews controls and PV, cancels a PV, manages fine status, exports statistics.

roles.name: Payment & Finance Manager
roles.description: Records fine payments, issues receipts, voids payments recorded by mistake and follows collection statistics.

roles.name: Unit Head (revenue)
roles.description: Unit head: follows the revenue collected by the unit's agents, verifies the daily closings and controls the deposits.

roles.name: Traffic Read-only
roles.description: Consultation only: traffic controls, PV, fines, drivers, vehicles and the offence catalogue.
